title: Statin initiation and recurrent MI among patients with prior MI

target_trial.population: Patients with a documented prior MI who are alive and eligible at the index discharge.
target_trial.intervention: Initiate a statin around the index discharge under a prespecified regimen.
target_trial.comparator: Do not initiate a statin around the index discharge.
target_trial.outcome: First subsequent/recurrent MI after index discharge.
target_trial.follow_up: From index discharge to a prespecified horizon; death before MI is a competing event.
target_trial.intended_estimand: Difference in cumulative incidence of recurrent MI by the prespecified horizon under the two initiation strategies.
target_trial.operationalization_status: Not currently established. The master has statin_before, a recent pre-admission prescription/order indicator, not index-discharge initiation, administration, adherence, or a reliable new-user classification. Existing prescription and EMAR processing does not by itself establish an initiation time or a common time zero.

nodes.temporal_status: Baseline candidate; source time relative to discharge assignment must be confirmed.

nodes.label: Diabetes

nodes.label: Hypertension

nodes.label: CKD

nodes.label: Prior cardiovascular disease
nodes.measurement_status: Potentially reconstructable from longitudinal diagnoses; no validated baseline feature is available.
nodes.temporal_status: Must be restricted to diagnoses before treatment assignment.

nodes.label: Lipid / atherosclerotic burden
nodes.measurement_status: Important common cause; outpatient lipid coverage is limited and no validated pre-treatment value is in the master.
nodes.temporal_status: A value must precede assignment; acute measurements may follow illness or treatment.

nodes.label: Documented prior MI eligibility (binary)
nodes.measurement_status: Present in master, but its source-history cutoff is unverified.
nodes.temporal_status: Defines eligibility and is fixed by the selected population; do not treat it as a varying adjustment covariate.

nodes.label: Number of prior MI episodes
nodes.measurement_status: Candidate requiring reconstruction from distinct MI admissions strictly before index; no validated master field.
nodes.temporal_status: Pre-index history; varies within the prior-MI-eligible population.

nodes.label: Time since most recent MI
nodes.measurement_status: Candidate requiring validated MI dates and index time; no validated master field.
nodes.temporal_status: Must be calculated from the most recent prior MI, not a future or index event.

nodes.label: Previous cardiovascular interventions
nodes.measurement_status: Candidate requiring reconstruction; no validated intervention history field is in the master.
nodes.temporal_status: Only interventions before assignment qualify as baseline history.

nodes.label: Prior MI severity / history
nodes.measurement_status: No validated severity or episode-history feature is in the master.
nodes.temporal_status: Must summarize events strictly before index assignment.

nodes.label: Prior statin use
nodes.measurement_status: Actual use and complete lookback are not established; statin_before is only an order/prescription proxy.
nodes.temporal_status: Must precede index-discharge initiation; continuation and new use must be distinguished.

nodes.label: Pre-assignment clinical state / severity
nodes.measurement_status: No single validated master field; acute vitals/labs may be post-origin or indication-driven.
nodes.temporal_status: Include only if measured before treatment assignment.

nodes.label: Unmeasured atherosclerotic risk / indication
nodes.measurement_status: Latent common cause including incompletely measured CAD burden, dyslipidemia, clinician-perceived risk, and related indication.
nodes.temporal_status: Pre-assignment common-cause hypothesis; residual confounding expected.

nodes.label: Recorded clinical indication
nodes.measurement_status: No validated indication field is available in the master.
nodes.temporal_status: A candidate proxy only if recorded before assignment; does not replace underlying risk.

nodes.label: Baseline aspirin / beta blocker / ACE inhibitor
nodes.measurement_status: Master indicators are prescription/order proxies; actual use and timing are unverified.
nodes.temporal_status: Candidate only when confirmed before statin assignment; concurrent post-assignment therapy is not baseline.

nodes.label: Healthcare access / utilization
nodes.measurement_status: Not adequately measured; admission and insurance fields may be incomplete proxies.
nodes.temporal_status: Baseline access can affect prescribing, cohort selection, follow-up, and outcome ascertainment.

nodes.label: Survival to index discharge
nodes.measurement_status: Index-death fields exist in longitudinal source tables; index cohort not constructed.
nodes.temporal_status: Eligibility/survival condition before the proposed discharge assignment.

nodes.label: Selected: documented prior MI and index-discharge survivor
nodes.measurement_status: Design restriction; requires validated prior MI and index eligibility.
nodes.temporal_status: Conditioned on by the target population definition.

nodes.label: Statin initiation at index discharge
nodes.measurement_status: Target intervention; not established by current statin_before field.
nodes.temporal_status: Assignment at/around index discharge; exact rule and time zero unresolved.

nodes.label: Recorded index-discharge statin order
nodes.measurement_status: Candidate order measurement; source linkage and initiation rule have not been validated.
nodes.temporal_status: Should record the treatment strategy at assignment; an order is not administration or adherence.

nodes.label: Recent pre-admission statin order proxy
nodes.measurement_status: Present in master; prescription/order presence, not confirmed use.
nodes.temporal_status: Pre-admission window; not a measure of initiation at index discharge.
nodes.adjustment_note: Do not adjust for this proxy by default. It is a common effect of prior statin use and healthcare access/documentation (prior_statin_use -> statin_before_proxy <- healthcare_access); conditioning on it can open a collider path. It is also an imperfect prescription measurement, not a sufficient substitute for prior use or index-discharge initiation.

nodes.label: Post-assignment receipt / adherence
nodes.measurement_status: Not established by prescription presence; EMAR records administrations but are not a complete outpatient adherence measure.
nodes.temporal_status: Post-assignment mediator; do not adjust for the total effect.

nodes.label: Post-assignment monitoring / healthcare contact
nodes.measurement_status: Not represented as a validated longitudinal measure.
nodes.temporal_status: Post-assignment; may mediate care and outcome ascertainment, and may be a collider.

nodes.label: True subsequent / recurrent MI
nodes.measurement_status: Target clinical outcome; current MI-coded admissions do not alone establish incident clinical MI.
nodes.temporal_status: After index discharge and within a prespecified horizon.

nodes.label: Death before recurrent MI
nodes.measurement_status: Death dates/flags exist in longitudinal artifacts; competing-risk cohort is not constructed.
nodes.temporal_status: Competing event during follow-up, not a baseline adjustment variable.

nodes.label: Follow-up / outcome observation
nodes.measurement_status: Observation-end artifact exists; completeness and anomalous dates require resolution.
nodes.temporal_status: Post-baseline observation/censoring process; informative censoring is not ruled out.

nodes.label: Recorded subsequent MI-coded admission
nodes.measurement_status: Longitudinal MI-coded admissions are available; code does not prove incident clinical MI.
nodes.temporal_status: Outcome measurement after index; requires distinct admission and follow-up validation.

nodes.label: Pre-exposure ECG state (quarantined)
nodes.measurement_status: Engineered ECG features exist, but treatment-relative timing is unresolved.
nodes.temporal_status: Not included in active graph until a pre-assignment rule is validated.

nodes.label: z_ecg representation (quarantined)
nodes.measurement_status: Latent ECG representation; provenance and causal interpretation are unresolved.
nodes.temporal_status: Not included in active graph.

nodes.label: Pre-exposure laboratory state (quarantined)
nodes.measurement_status: Potential lipid and other lab measures; master coverage and time eligibility are unresolved.
nodes.temporal_status: Not included in active graph until linked measures are shown to precede assignment.

ECG physiology could predict recurrence, but the index ECG and temporal eligibility are not established.
Do not treat latent ECG embeddings as causal covariates without provenance and pre-treatment timing.

excluded_candidates.reason: In-hospital treatment with unresolved ordering; not baseline discharge initiation.
Post-discharge treatment is downstream of the proposed assignment.
Acute severity/treatment variables may be post-assignment and are not baseline confounders.
Outcome or outcome-derived timing metadata; not baseline adjustment variables.
Excluded from the active DAG until provenance and pre-treatment temporal eligibility are defensible.

clinical_assumptions_requiring_validatio: The index cohort can be defined without selecting on future treatment, future admission, or future MI.
The modeled baseline state and co-medications precede discharge assignment.
The assumed causes of treatment choice and recurrence are clinically plausible for the intended MIMIC population.
The selected prior-MI survivor cohort induces no unaddressed selection bias beyond the modeled mechanisms.
A statin initiation strategy has sufficiently well-defined versions (drug, dose, and assignment rule).
data_limitations: statin_before is a recent pre-admission prescription/order proxy, not verified initiation at index discharge, administration, or adherence.
Complete prior statin use and new-user eligibility are not established.
The master is ECG-linked and is not a validated complete longitudinal at-risk cohort.
Baseline timing and history cutoffs for comorbidity fields are unresolved.
Prior MI episode count, recency, severity, and previous cardiovascular interventions are candidates requiring reconstruction; no validated master fields are established.
Lipids, atherosclerotic burden, prior MI severity, smoking, frailty, treatment indication, and healthcare access are incompletely measured or unavailable.
ECG-medication linkage is incomplete; ECG features and z_ecg are not active adjustment nodes.
Death is a competing event and observation-end anomalies require resolution before follow-up analysis.
The follow-up horizon and index-discharge treatment assignment window are not specified.
The executable SCM is an unfitted architecture; its synthetic test coefficients are not empirical and its one-horizon event probabilities are not a survival model.
MI-coded admissions do not alone establish incident clinical MI or complete outcome ascertainment.
causal_use: This DAG defines candidate structural relationships and separates treatment assignment, adherence mediators, competing death, outcome measurement, and selection. The companion SCM is a parameterized, unfitted architecture. Once treatment timing, cohort, outcome, horizon, and covariates are validated, it can guide structural equations and counterfactual risk queries; neither the graph nor executable architecture establishes causal identification.
